pairing_hash_note: Recomputed and checked by tests/contracts/maps/test_map_contracts.py; written by `python3 maps/r4/rehash.py`.
source_profiles_note: Base Observation only. Q-A2-1 is open: whether the BP family claims http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/vitalsigns and .../bp conformance. Claiming them would require Observation.category and the 85354-9 panel code, which the concept note does not specify. The source shape accepts 8480-6 or 85354-9 as the parent code so either answer is a value-set edit.

pivot_variables.name: panel
pivot_variables.target_role: node key input; the repetition key
notes: This is the repetition key the concept note section 5 requirement is written against: the tuple multiset is keyed on it.

pivot_variables.name: panelCode
notes: R9 option B: the panel code does NOT type the panel record node. LOINC 85354-9 is `proposed` in the code table and therefore yields source-only. Bound so it cannot be dropped silently.

pivot_variables.name: subjectRef
notes: bp-other-patient has two panels with two different subjects, so this is resolved per resource.

pivot_variables.name: sysCode
notes: Guarded to LOINC 8480-6. THIS is what keeps (bp-1,120,80) from becoming (bp-1,80,120): the systolic value is bound by the constraint whose code is 8480-6, not by position and not by fhir:index.

pivot_variables.name: diaCode
notes: Guarded to LOINC 8462-4. Optional: bp-component-omitted has no diastolic component.

pivot_variables.name: diaValue
notes: Also the `requires_source_binding` gate for the four diastolic passes. When it is unbound, no diastolic node exists at all; the slot is empty, never borrowed.

pivot_variables.name: diaUnit
notes: Both components are pinned to mm[Hg], so one shared sulo:Unit node serves both. A component in a different unit fails the source shape rather than silently sharing a unit node across dimensions.

repetition_scopes.name: panel
repetition_scopes.note: ONE iteration per map run. Concept note section 5's two panels are two Observation resources and therefore two runs (DR-302), which is why the two panels can never share a binding context. Within a run there is no repeating triple constraint at all: the two components are two max-1 constraints discriminated by LOINC code, not a `component*`. The acceptance multiset is assembled across runs and compared as a sorted list.

node_key_rules._why: CD-1: no id() in the pinned engine; node identity is declared here, not computed by the engine.

terminology_dependencies: policies/code-interpretation.v1.json :: CODE-LOINC-8480-6, CODE-LOINC-8462-4 -- pilot-provisional, clinical_signoff false
policies/code-interpretation.v1.json :: CODE-LOINC-85354-9 -- `proposed`, yields source-only, NOT used to type anything [R9]
expected_failures: a systolic component absent -- the systolic constraint is required
a component unit other than mm[Hg], including kPa (unit conversion is disabled by policy)
a component valueQuantity carrying a comparator -- the CLOSED Quantity shapes reject it
two systolic components in one Observation -- rejected, because it would hide which value is the systolic one
any Observation element outside the CLOSED shape, including modifierExtension
allowed_alternative_shapes: sh:BPPanelRecordNode / sh:BPPanelRecordNodeWithDiastolic -- two entry shapes for the panel record, selected by whether the source bound a diastolic component. Both have every constraint required, so lastReport.unboundVariables != [] stays an unconditional error (DR-301 blocker 8c) and both revalidate against the graph they produce.
sh:BPPersonNode / sh:BPPersonNodeWithDiastolic -- the same pair for the person node.
bp-component-omitted selects the first of each pair; the graph then carries no diastolic quantity, no diastolic quality and no diastolic member triple.
static_analysis_note: CD-1: no static checker ships and Agent 4's linter has not landed, so this stays false.
The three obligations are asserted at run time on all five BP fixtures plus both RDF variants by tests/contracts/maps/test_bp_gate3.py.

An optional target constraint was measured and rejected: with `sulo:refersTo IRI ? %Map:{ v:diaResult %}` and diaResult unsupplied, the engine emits the correct graph but still lists diaResult in lastReport.unboundVariables, which would make the blocker-8c check unusable. Hence the alternative shapes.
inverse_coverage_note: tests/contracts/maps/test_inverse_pivot.py revalidates each materialized node against this target schema and asserts the recovered bindings.

Same FINDING as the eGFR map: sh:BPSystolicQualityNode, sh:BPDiastolicQualityNode, sh:BPPersonSystolicNode and sh:BPPersonDiastolicNode each carry two variable-bound rdf:type constraints, so the inverse recovers the correct SET of classes with an arbitrary variable assignment. The quantity nodes are unaffected, because their second rdf:type is the constant [sulo:Quantity].
